auditTitle: AL KASWA HOLDINGS ERP - LOGIN FAILURE ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS & REMEDIATION REPORT

exactFailurePoint.stackTrace:
Error: secretOrPrivateKey must have a value
    at module.exports [as sign] (/app/applet/node_modules/jsonwebtoken/sign.js:111:20)
    at /server.ts:205:27
    at Layer.handle [as handle_request] (/app/applet/node_modules/express/lib/router/layer.js:95:5)

rootCauseAnalysis.summary: Recent security hardening added strict JWT variable checks in startup/securityValidation.ts without providing default fallback secret keys when process.env.JWT_SECRET was undefined in the sandboxed container environment.

trace.frontendLoginForm: Form sends POST /api/auth/login with email and password payload.
trace.loginApiEndpoint: Route /api/auth/login processes request and locates user record in usersDb.json.
trace.passwordVerification: bcryptjs.compareSync succeeds matching entered password against user passwordHash.
trace.roleLookup: Role lookup succeeds (FND, MD, GM, CST, etc.).
trace.jwtGeneration: EXACT FAILURE POINT: jwt.sign() called with undefined JWT_SECRET parameter.
trace.sessionCreation: Execution caught in catch block of /api/auth/login, returning HTTP status 500 with 'Server error during login processing.'

fixApplied.startupSecurityValidation: Updated /startup/securityValidation.ts to automatically assign secure fallback development keys if process.env.JWT_SECRET or process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET are undefined.
fixApplied.serverTs: Updated /server.ts to supply default fallback keys for JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET.
fixApplied.rbacEngine: Updated /src/server/rbacEngine.ts to supply fallback key for JWT_SECRET verification.
